http/content_coding#

Content codings (RFC 9110 §8.4): the names in Content-Encoding and Accept-Encoding.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

ContentCoding("GZip").string();          // "gzip"

Description#

Content codings (RFC 9110 §8.4): the names in Content-Encoding and Accept-Encoding.

Names are case-insensitive and kept lowercase. This is only the name; the codecs are in http/body_coding.

Public API#

object ContentCoding#

object ContentCoding

A canonical coding identity, not a compressor and not an installed-codec observation. Wildcards belong to negotiation. No I/O or algorithm fallback.

ContentCoding.ContentCoding#

ContentCoding(origin is string)

Checks origin as a token; * and anything else are InvalidContentCoding.

ContentCoding.string#

string() is string

The name, lowercase.

Errors#

enum InvalidContentCoding#

enum InvalidContentCoding is Error = (origin(origin is string))

A name that is not a coding.
